title: DoctrineEntry
description: A single Doctrine entry. Use this schema to validate one entry in isolation — for example a markdown file's YAML frontmatter under doctrine/. The aggregate Doctrine document (doctrine.schema.json) wraps an array of these.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id. Doctrine ids should not change once published; rename via 'replaces'.

body.description: Markdown content. Should remain low-churn; if churn is high, the entry probably belongs in Backpack instead.

applies_to.description: Renderer or surface ids this entry should govern.

routing.description: Optional routing rules, used when kind = 'routing-rule'.

consent.description: Optional consent-posture definition, used when kind = 'policy' and the policy governs ingestion or rendering of sensitive material. Pathways MUST consult this before crossing the named scope; renderers MUST consult it before exposing material in the named scope.

posture.description: opt-in = MUST have explicit consent before ingestion. opt-out = ingest by default, MUST honor an opt-out signal. forbidden = MUST NOT ingest under any circumstances. allow = no consent gate (use sparingly, only for clearly user-authored data).

applies_to_pathways.description: Ingestion pathway ids this consent governs (e.g. 'transcripts', 'narrator-vault').

applies_to_renderers.description: Renderer/surface ids this consent governs at output time.

requires.description: Required preconditions for ingestion or rendering when posture allows it (e.g. 'redact PII before storage', 'attach source citation').

rationale.description: One- or two-sentence reason this posture exists. Helps reviewers reason about exceptions.

gate_message.description: Optional template a renderer SHOULD use when reporting the consent gate firing. Supports the placeholder {count} for the suppressed-item count. Renderers fall back to a generic count-only message when this is absent. MUST NOT name suppressed items.

gate_message_short.description: Optional compact form of gate_message for ambient/single-line surfaces (e.g. statusline). Supports {count}. Renderers fall back to gate_message, then to a generic short token, when this is absent.

voice.description: Optional voice/skin definition, used when kind = 'voice-rule'. Renderers consult this to translate the same facts into the configured tone without changing the underlying state.

scope.description: Renderer/surface ids the voice rule applies to (e.g. 'narrator-list', 'narrator-brief'). Empty = applies anywhere narrator voice is requested. Voice-rule selection is identical for both narrator surfaces (see ADR 0005 clarification 2026-04-29).

register.description: Coarse tonal register. Renderers may map this to LLM prompts or template variants.

do.description: Affirmative voice rules ('lead with the body check', 'name the smallest next step').

avoid.description: Things this voice must not do ('no ranked priority lists', 'no hustle vocabulary').

facts_stable.description: If true (the default), the voice rule MUST NOT alter underlying facts when reframing them.

replaces.description: Id of a prior doctrine entry this one supersedes.

sources.description: Hoard ids, file paths, or URLs where the truth originates.
